Give Us Another

Jesse Smith and Colm Gannon play this reel as “Give Us Another” citing the old recording of Mayo fiddler John McFadden as the source. Watch them play it together: http://youtu.be/AxHjNxs21M0

↳ Posted by slainte on May 19th, 2012.

The Braes of Auchtertyre

This tune was originally a Scottish reel entitled “The Braes of Auchtertyre”. It appears in the Gunn Book, Co. Fermanagh as “The Braes of Auchintyre”, in the Francis Reynolds MS c.1885 of Gaigue, Ballinamuck, Co. Longford as “Miss Mulligan’s Reel” and in the American fiddle tradition as “Billy on the Low Ground”.

↳ Posted by ConorW on March 2nd, 2015.
